Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "this card can't be attacked" [Opponent's Turn] skill mean?

Card Q&A.a: This card's effect only prevents your opponent's Digimon from attacking you, so blocking will work as normal.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if this card activates  and blocks the attack of one of my opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: A [Hybrid] trait Digimon card or a blue Tamer card.
Card Q&A.q: What digivolution card must be present for this card's [Opponent’s Turn] effect to activate?

Effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
